options.text: The moss is living because it shows growth and other life processes; the dormant bean can be living too if it can grow when conditions suit; the toy only moves when wound and is not living.
The dry bean is dead because it is not moving right now.
The moss is non-living because it stays rooted and never walks from place to place.
The wind-up toy is living because it moves across the ground.

stem: Nidhi finds a dry dormant bean, a patch of growing moss on a damp wall, and a wind-up toy car near the garden. She wants to decide which is living. Which choice uses shared life characteristics rather than one visible sign?

teacher.key_rationale: Living status rests on shared life characteristics. Dormant seeds can still be living; rooted moss is living; motion alone does not make a toy living.
